texts.SamplePageMessage: A sample page for the Sites module
texts.Sites:010001: The route '{Route}' is already used by another page.
texts.Sites:010003: '{Pattern}' is not a valid content path pattern: it must contain the {{slug}} placeholder.
texts.Sites:020001: A content type named '{Name}' already exists on this page.
texts.Sites:020002: The field '{FieldId}' is referenced more than once by this content type.
texts.Sites:030002: The field '{Name}' is a platform preset and cannot be deleted. Remove it from a content type's arrangement instead of deleting the definition.
texts.Sites:030003: The field '{Name}' is a platform preset and cannot be renamed. Its display name can still be changed.
texts.Sites:040001: The slug '{Slug}' is already used by another '{CultureName}' content on this page.
texts.Sites:040002: The content type '{ContentTypeId}' belongs to a different page than the one given.
texts.Sites:040003: A draft cannot have a publish time in the future ('{PublishTime}'). Set status to Published to schedule it for then.
texts.Sites:050001: This site has no primary domain configured, so absolute URLs cannot be generated. Set the 'Primary domain' setting.
texts.Description:Sites.EnabledLanguages: Comma-separated culture names (e.g. "en,fr,zh-Hans") this site serves. The first one is the default language: its URLs carry no language prefix, while the others are served under "/{culture}/".
texts.Description:Sites.PrimaryDomain: The site's primary absolute address, e.g. "https://example.com". Sitemap, robots.txt, feeds and canonical URLs are all built on it, so that a custom domain and a platform subdomain never compete as duplicate content. Leave empty to use the address each request arrives on.
texts.Description:Sites.EnableLlmsTxt: Publish an /llms.txt index of this site's pages. Optional and off by default: adoption is around 10% and Google has stated it does not support it, so it is not a ranking mechanism.
texts.Description:Sites.Robots.AllowIndexing: Whether search engines are allowed to index this site.
texts.Description:Sites.Robots.AllowAiTraining: Allow crawlers that train AI models (GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, CCBot).
texts.Description:Sites.Robots.AllowAiSearch: Allow crawlers that power AI search/RAG answers (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Claude-SearchBot).
texts.ContentTypeStillHasContents: This content type still has contents; delete or move them first.
texts.FieldGroupNameAlreadyExists: A field group named '{0}' already exists.
texts.Validate:InvalidSeoValue: The value of '{0}' is not a valid SEO field value.
